evals.expected_output: Says to break the topic into 3-5 research sub-questions before searching, rather than searching the broad topic directly.

evals.prompt: While researching a topic I found one blog post claiming a surprising statistic, and no other source mentions it. Per the deep-research quality rules, how should I handle this in the final report?
evals.expected_output: Says to flag the claim as unverified or single-sourced rather than presenting it as an established fact.

assertions.text: Flags it as unverified or single-sourced
